component.name: Athena
component.summary: Manage software from all your package sources

description.p: Athena brings your distribution's package manager, Flatpak, Snap and the Arch User Repository together in a GTK application.
Discover applications, review updates and dependencies, manage repositories, and follow each transaction's progress. AUR builds require editable source review before execution.

Inspect cleanup candidates, back up configuration and Flatpak data, export package choices, and manage configured Snapper or Timeshift snapshots. Optional background checks notify you when updates are available.

screenshot.caption: Review software updates and recent activity on Home
Review AUR build files before installation

description.p: Replaces the Qt application with GTK 4 and libadwaita, reviewed AUR builds, application discovery, recovery tools and desktop update notifications.
